name: Carson
tagline: Deploys a starter crew of household life-admin assistants in one step
description: A one-move starter kit for personal life administration: it brings up a small team of household assistants at once, each with its own remit, and you keep the set as issued or swap members. The premise is that errands and follow-ups quietly eat a whole week, and a standing crew wins that time back.
author: aarwen7
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
